1.Name: TexasRenters (docker)
1.Comment: Host is the Compose service name, not localhost: inside pgAdmin's container localhost is pgAdmin itself. Port is 5432, the container port, not the shifted host port. No password is stored here - pgAdmin asks once and can remember it.

2.Name: TexasRenters (application role)
2.Comment: The least-privilege role the backend actually uses. Connect as this to see what the application sees: row-level security applies, so with no app.organization_id set the policed tables read as empty. That is the fail-closed behaviour working, not a broken connection - the postgres entry above bypasses it because it owns the tables.
